project.name: open-evora
project.objective: Discovery and evidence-based civic problem intelligence for Évora, with an open civic data infrastructure track; no product implementation authorized yet
targetUsers: residents, students, workers, businesses, public bodies, and visitors in Évora

constraints: Documentation/research-first repository: no application framework, database, or cloud infrastructure during D1.
Substantive Évora research is performed externally and integrated via reviewed handoffs (docs/discovery/research-handoff-protocol.md).
Research records use the YAML schemas in research/schemas/ and are validated with tools/research/ (typed, minimal dependency surface).
nonGoals: No civic product selection during D1.
No Évora Open API implementation during D1.
No cloud, frontend, or database technology selection during D1.
technologyPreferences: Node.js (already available) for the research-record validator.
